run.name: Iron Mountain Inc
run.title: CP-OS host session (IRM)
run.summary: Iron Mountain is a large, cash-generative but highly levered REIT: debt is 6.22x LTM Adjusted EBITDA and free cash flow is negative, so the credit depends on continued market access and data center lease commencements. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is IRON MOUNTAIN INC.

revenue.basis: Total revenues, as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Debt 17,972,202 thousand (10-Q Q3 page:19-20) over LTM Adjusted EBITDA 2,888,192 thousand derived as FY2025 plus nine months 2026 (2,182,915) less nine months 2025 (1,868,673), 10-Q Q3 page:42; cash 188,160 thousand. Derived LTM; principal basis (18,096,426 thousand) gives 6.27x.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. LTM Adjusted EBITDA 2,888,192 thousand over LTM cash interest 914,978 thousand (FY2025 plus nine months 2026 801,904 less nine months 2025 711,517, 10-Q Q3 page:7). Derived LTM; 2026 capitalized interest is not disclosed in the pinned 10-Qs.

cash.basis: Cash. Cash from 10-Q Q3 page:2; revolver availability as printed (10-Q Q3 page:20). Same basis; other undrawn lines of about 207.9 US$m are listed in Calculations and excluded.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Adjusted EBITDA is a management measure, covenant ratios use other definitions, and no ratings, indentures or Q3 2026 maturity table are supplied.
CP-1 main limitation: Adjusted EBITDA is a management measure, covenant ratios use other definitions, and no maturity table exists after December 31, 2025.
